events.label: Arkansas disability Medicaid waiver waitlist and funding status

slots.name: waitlist size
slots.sentence: And yet, more than 2,400 people in Arkansas – and 650,000 nationwide – appear on waitlists for those Medicaid services.

slots.name: budgeted waivers
slots.sentence: But in Arkansas, legislators only budgeted enough money to provide Medicaid waivers to 8,233 people.

slots.name: annual waitlist growth
slots.sentence: Each year the list grows by about 500 people, said Melissa Weatherton, who oversees specialty Medicaid services for the Arkansas Department of Health.

slots.name: cost ratio home vs institutional
slots.sentence: Plus, care at home and in the community is, on average, three times cheaper than institutional treatment, research shows.

slots.name: priority categories
slots.sentence: By state rules, services are prioritized for people who want to leave an institution and those who are at immediate risk of entering one.

slots.name: child share of waitlist
slots.sentence: Maceo is among thousands more waiting. About two-thirds are children.
